backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date plus prior close history needed for 20-day industry relative strength, 5-day extension control, same-day industry repair, group-level signal-day volume breadth, 60-day trend guard, ADV, candidate volume ratio, and realized volatility. Paper entry is next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The industry volume-breadth laggard repair source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry/candidate_pool: broad industry volume participation may identify real fund-flow diffusion before the lagging participant fully catches up.

2_history_check.exp-20260606-015: Low-vol 20d-high breakout improved aggregate EV but failed two windows and worsened drawdown; this avoids raw breakout and requires group-level volume breadth plus laggard repair.
2_history_check.exp-20260607-007/008: Industry laggard repair was accepted; this is a scout for a different relation requiring industry-wide volume participation, not a retune of that shared helper.
2_history_check.exp-20260607-009: Pullback leader resilience failed as likely leader exhaustion; this excludes leaders by requiring below-group 20-day position.
2_history_check.exp-20260607-010: Breadth repair second-line failed the old_thin window; this adds a distinct volume participation field rather than sweeping the price-breadth threshold.
2_history_check.exp-20260607-012: Dispersion-compression repair regressed old_thin and drawdown; this removes the prior-dispersion condition and tests volume breadth as the independent relation.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Accept only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, no EV/PnL regression window, target sample >=20 across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, and concentration guard passes.

hypothesis: In strong liquid industry groups, broad signal-day volume participation may identify real fund-flow diffusion. The best replacement candidate should be a 20-day laggard that also repairs versus SPY and participates in the volume thrust.
interpretation: The industry volume-breadth laggard repair source did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it or answer by retuning group volume breadth, candidate volume ratio, signal-day repair, lag, close-location, hold-day, cooldown, top-N, or notional thresholds on these frozen windows.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that group-level volume breadth still behaves like a crowded momentum chase or a near-neighbor of accepted laggard repair rather than a distinct replacement edge.
next_evidence_needed: Independent PIT context or shared-adapter forward rows are required before retrying near-neighbor industry volume breadth repair variants.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping group volume breadth, member volume-ratio threshold, high-volume positive fraction, candidate volume ratio, signal-day group repair, lag, signal relative strength, close-location, volatility, hold-day, top-N, cooldown, or paper notional thresholds.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry requires independent PIT confirmation such as earnings peer provenance, news/event catalyst context, options/borrow/ownership data with adequate history, or closed forward rows from a shared default-off adapter.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The candidate source failed to add robust replacement value, regressed a canonical window, or breached drawdown/concentration gates. That means group-level volume breadth did not reliably separate real fund-flow diffusion from noisy catch-up under existing costs, slippage, and 10-day exit assumptions.

prediction.confidence_reason: Accepted industry laggard repair suggests industry-relative replacement can carry signal, while price-breadth and dispersion-compression neighbors failed. This tests whether group-level volume participation is a distinct free-OHLCV flow field instead of another momentum relabel.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result would require a shared default-off adapter that computes the same broad warehouse liquid sector-known universe, PIT industry grouping, 20-day group strength, signal-day volume breadth, high-volume positive participation, laggard repair fields, same-ticker core-overlap exclusion, next-open paper entry, 10-trading-day exit, costs, cooldown, and concentration controls in both replay and daily production before any report queue, paper ledger, candidate priority, sizing, watchlist, or order surface could change.
